original_findings.title: Child-process environment and raw-log Secret boundary

original_findings.title: Query, Git/worktree and process lifecycle side effects

new_findings.title: Preflight catch reanchors already-detected tampered task state; recovery preserves a lowered budget
new_findings.precondition: Local state row was corrupted or modified outside the event writer. A later explicit recovery call is required for the observed budget restart; this is not a demonstrated unauthenticated remote exploit.
new_findings.observed: bRound 9 -> raw task row 0 -> verify rejects -> run preflight rejects but saves BLOCKED -> verify now accepts -> fixture human recovery retains 0 -> B_ENTER increments to 1; actual model calls 0.
new_findings.minimal_fix: Validate before all mutations; quarantine a corrupted task without hashing it into a new trusted state. Recovery must verify/reconstruct the last trusted state and preserve consumed budget; apply the same check before approval/recovery writes.

new_findings.title: Artifact file is durable before its SQLite transaction, leaving accepted unregistered orphans and EEXIST retry failures
new_findings.observed: Injected ARTIFACT_REGISTERED event failure rolls back manifest but leaves orphan.json. verify accepts the task; same-name retry returns EEXIST. No actual power failure was injected.
new_findings.minimal_fix: Introduce recoverable pending artifact/temporary-file protocol and compare manifest with directory contents; define crash/retry reconciliation without silent deletion.

new_findings.title: inspect() combines different database versions without a read transaction
new_findings.observed: Two real SQLite connections, with a deterministic writer between SELECTs: inspect reports aRound 1 while its successfully verified ledger belongs to aRound 2. This is controlled interleaving, not a concurrency stress benchmark.
new_findings.minimal_fix: Read task, dispatches, events and artifact manifests from a single read transaction/version; report the version with the response.

new_findings.title: Readonly status of an existing WAL database creates persistent -wal/-shm files
new_findings.observed: Real status CLI exits 0, leaves workflow.sqlite-wal and workflow.sqlite-shm; main DB bytes unchanged. This is SQLite filesystem behavior, not evidence of database data writes.
new_findings.minimal_fix: Specify readOnly as database-level semantics, or provide a consistent offline read-only snapshot. Do not use immutable=1 on a live changing WAL database merely to suppress side files.

new_findings.title: Remote Git helper remains outside the environment allowlist
new_findings.observed: A real subprocess invoked through remote.run observes the synthetic unrelated environment sentinel; child_env-protected Harness does not.
new_findings.minimal_fix: Pass an explicit minimal environment to every remote Git/helper/spawn path; test optional envAllowList entries and authentication without reading credentials.

new_findings.title: Markdown deliverables and remote legacy verdicts still lack a consistent approved contract
new_findings.observed: Markdown followed by final JSON is rejected locally; raw legacy APPROVE becomes QUESTION remotely. Historical Soul migration is explicitly pending.
new_findings.minimal_fix: Obtain approval for the Soul migration and Markdown/JSON/commit/phase/evidence mapping; use the same verdict normalization at local and remote boundaries and verify real outputs later.

new_findings.title: Original Python offline test is not green on the actual Windows host
new_findings.observed: Original suite: one ERROR, exit 1; diagnostic repeat records status exit 1 / WinError 87 before the cleanup error. A signal-mocked path confirms it reaches os.kill(pid,0); no extra OS signal was sent by the probe.
new_findings.minimal_fix: Declare Runner target-platform support and separate/implement platform-aware liveness. Retain primary stderr and wait for owned fixture jobs before cleanup. A real Linux Runner acceptance remains separately NOT_VERIFIED; this local failure does not prove Linux fails.

new_findings.title: Early BLOCKED tasks without a currentSha cannot use the public recovery CLI
new_findings.observed: An early definitely BLOCKED fixture has currentSha=null. recover without --sha exits 1 (required --sha); with a nonempty SHA exits 1 (not the approved recovery basis). No model or SDK was connected. This does not claim the direct JavaScript API cannot accept null.
new_findings.minimal_fix: Define an explicit no-commit recovery basis for pre-commit phases, bind it to the frozen task/spec digest and preserve the approval receipt; test CLI and API consistently.

new_findings.title: Porcelain parsing and trim() bypass sensitive-path commit checks
new_findings.observed: Real disposable repositories with synthetic .env contents only: rename raw R ordinary.txt / .env is checked as ordinary.txt and v, then committed. For a tracked .env edit, must().trim() removes the leading status space, checked path becomes env, and the change is committed. Neither repository has a remote; no real credential or GitHub write occurred.
new_findings.minimal_fix: Preserve raw porcelain bytes without trimming, parse NUL-separated status and rename/copy pairs correctly, and validate both original and destination paths plus staged object modes before commit.

new_findings.title: One successful reviewer result is omitted from Controller evidence when its peer fails
new_findings.observed: The actual PaseoAgentRuntime.execute with an in-process fake SDK produces one TERMINAL dispatch and one ACKNOWLEDGED dispatch. invokePair saves only peer errors, no successful raw report artifact/history; verify accepts the event chain. Workflow stops; this is missing evidence, not a gate bypass. External daemon transcript storage was not examined.
new_findings.minimal_fix: Persist each settled result, its role/phase/agent/dispatch IDs and raw evidence separately before recording the pair failure; retain uncertainty for the failed seat and prohibit blind redispatch.
